fields.label: Allowed HERO Hosts
fields.description: One exact HTTPS hostname per line.

fields.label: HERO Source Instance
fields.description: Stable source-instance identity used together with ProjectMatch.id. Change only for a separate HERO source.

fields.label: Confirm Source Binding
fields.description: Confirm that the configured endpoint and API token belong to the HERO account named by the source instance. Required after the endpoint, token or source instance changes; use a new source instance for a different HERO account.

fields.label: Schema Refresh Interval Minutes
fields.description: 10 through 240 minutes. The live HERO schema is reloaded on this interval once the API token is verified; an unchanged schema keeps its snapshot.

fields.label: Allow GraphQL Mutation Execution
fields.description: Global fail-closed gate. System Manager activation still requires an active schema-bound contract and explicit confirmation for every individual mutation.

fields.label: Allow deletion
fields.description: Global fail-closed deletion gate. Turning this off blocks manual, queued and automatic HERO Integration deletions and invalidates prepared destructive work.

fields.label: Administrator Notification Recipients
fields.description: One enabled System Manager user ID per line. Empty uses all enabled System Managers for internal Frappe notifications.

fields.label: Testing Enabled
fields.description: Limits manual synchronization previews only. It never starts work by itself.

fields.label: Testing Max. Actions
fields.description: 1 through 100 external HERO GraphQL requests for one manual test preview.

fields.label: Polling Mode
fields.description: OFF never polls HERO records automatically; the schema refresh is separate. MONITOR observes and records technical results only. AUTO_SYNC is limited to approved HERO-to-Frappe mappings; it never executes HERO mutations.

fields.label: Polling Execution Window
fields.description: Optional HH:MM-HH:MM local-time window; empty means no additional window.

fields.label: Polling Pagination Strategy
fields.description: The approved HERO V1 reader has no cursor contract.

fields.label: Allow Reconciliation
fields.description: Reconciliation may report discrepancies; it never deletes ERPNext records automatically.

fields.label: Polling Concurrency
fields.description: The approved V1 source reader executes one request at a time.

fields.label: Sync Service Paused
fields.description: Set on the Synchronization page. Pausing stops new automatic runs without changing any polling setting.
